match.userMessage:
Rough storyboard sketch. Scene 6 — 5s
INT. SUBWAY PLATFORM — EVENING
Locked, eye-level. An express train slams past behind her, stainless steel doors strobing her reflection into a coral smear. Her hair lifts in the tunnel wind; she leans a fraction toward the moving steel, checking herself in a reflection too fast to hold, then laughs and gives up.

. Loose pencil line drawing on white paper, quick gestural strokes, minimal detail. Simple placeholder figures with blank featureless faces, basic shapes for the setting, flat grey marker shading. Monochrome, no colour, no rendering, no realism, no photographic detail. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
